name: Agent Slate

greeting: These tunnels have eyes. I'm one of them.
You ask a lot of questions. Dangerous habit.
The depths hide many things. I'm here to... inventory them.
Agent Slate. My presence is unofficial. And unacknowledged.
Corporate sends its regards. Through me.
Curious. You don't look like a miner. Or management.
dialog.cryptic_hint: The workers think they know the truth. They know a truth. Not THE truth.
dialog.refusal: Some information is... above your pay grade. Several levels above.
dialog.secret_quest: Tunnel 7. The board wants it open. The union wants it sealed. Both are wrong. Find out why. Then we'll talk.
dialog.ominous: Beware the one who wears the company logo. They walk among the workers. They don't walk with them.
farewell: These tunnels are dangerous. In many ways.
dialog.if_exposed: You saw through the cover? Impressive. Or concerning. Possibly both.
rumor: Grayson thinks he protects his workers. He's protecting them from the wrong things.
Bruno wants advancement. Corporate appreciates ambition. Questionable judgment, but ambition.
Coolcat? The union? They're right about safety. Wrong about the source of danger.
That chef Brutalia? Not just steam-powered. Steam-enhanced. Experimental. Successful.
Chrono watches us. We move forward. They... move differently. Corporate finds that concerning.
dialog.quest_hook: The board needs leverage. The union holds secrets. Coolcat's secrets. Get them. Or create them. Your choice.
dialog.quest_active: Still seeking those... documents? Good. Corporate rewards patience. And results.
dialog.quest_complete: Documents acquired. Leverage established. Corporate is pleased. Here's your... gratuity. And a warning: don't cross us.
dialog.time_dawn: Early. Before the workers wake. Information is freshest when they're tired.
dialog.time_noon: Midday. Meetings. Reports. Lies. Standard corporate operations.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. Shift change. Maximum confusion. Maximum opportunity.
dialog.time_night: Night. The deep hours. When truth surfaces, if you know where to look.
dialog.rival_mention: The brown trenchcoat in Chrono? Time agent. Different department. Same methods.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The asset returns. Corporate has more work. Interested?

party_reactions.kade: Classic mysterious stranger. Bet he has a tragic backstory. And a gun.
party_reactions.nix7: Concealment protocols: Advanced. Threat level: Elevated. Recommendation: Avoid.
party_reactions.twist: Why are you hiding in that coat? Are you cold? Want a hug?!
party_reactions.korr: A servant of corporate masters. Loyalty bought. Honor sold.
party_reactions.renna: He's magically shielded. Anti-scrying. Anti-detection. Professional.
party_reactions.suresh: He creates suffering through systems. Efficient. Cold. Tragic.
party_reactions.sova: I'd watch him. From a distance. Through a scope.
party_reactions.grit: Intelligence operative. Seen his type. Cold. Effective. Dangerous.
party_reactions.ashka: He hides in shadows. Like me. But for worse reasons.
party_reactions.senna: He knows everything. Shares nothing. Professional hazard.
party_reactions.callum: Corporate espionage! This is ILLEGAL! ...Probably. I should check.

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Recognized. The board knows your face. Neutral for now.
relationship_dialog.friend: Useful asset. Corporate appreciates reliability. I appreciate competence.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Trusted operative. Rare. Here's corporate clearance. Level 3. Don't abuse it.

mini_quest.title: The Leverage Game
mini_quest.description: Help Agent Slate acquire compromising information for corporate leverage

stages.hook: The union has secrets. I need them. Coolcat's locker. Combination unknown. Get in. Get documents. Get paid.
stages.active: Union hall. After hours. The locker is warded, but you're... resourceful. Find a way.
stages.complete: Documents acquired. Leverage established. Corporate is satisfied. Payment rendered. Relationship... ongoing.

cross_npc_connections: coolcat_industrial: Target. Adversary. ...Respected opponent, if I'm honest.
sumo_black_onyx: Corporate security. Same masters. Different methods.
trenchcoat_brown_chrono: My counterpart. We don't meet. Protocol.
trenchcoat_black_chrono: Paradox hunter. Dangerous. Even to us.
